title: Reunion in Havana: old friends, the ceremony and the medal
summary: He met Bola de Nieve, Miguelito Valdes, Gilberto Valdes, Cachao, Arcano and Arsenio Rodriguez, and was honored at City Hall.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: For instance like who, Macho? Who did you see at that reunion?
Ahhh Bola de Nieve, Miguelito Valdes, Lucho Batica, ahhh - Oh!! there were so many. Lucho Batica ...
Gilberto Valdes?
Gilberto Valdes, ahhh
Was Cachao there?
Cachao.
Arcaño?
Arcaño, Arseñio Rodriguez, ahh - it was a congregation of all the ....
So what did the musicians do there? Did they talk or what?
We talked like kids, you know, that you have the recession from the class that you start to playing in the playground. That's what actually happened.
Okay, was there a place where they had a ceremony where you all congregated?
Oh, yes, at the City Hall. We had a beautiful picture. I don't know where I put mine. Do you have my picture?
I have a copy of it.
You have that copy? I think I haven't got it, will you give me a copy?
Sure. Go ahead.
So, ahh that was beautiful, and the mayor
gave us a medal and a cocktail from Bacardi and the other company, Tropical, Polard, all those brewers, and we was all over the place.
So actually, what was it for, to honor the Cuban musicians and that?
To honor Cuban music.
I see.
I think ahhh, you know, Batista was an outstanding guy, very sentimental .....
Ah - Ha

... and it cost a lot of money, and then the ahhh give it the opportunity all those musicians that they haven't got the money, to see the parents. Those people they was for years without seeing the mother and father or uncle, whatever.
Was Chocolaté Armenteros there? All those Cuban musicians?
Yes.
Uh - Huh. Let's say, ahh - that lasted what - Two weeks?
Yes.
